selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c8eba47a...; reboot acknowledged; connection unreachable during reboot; new boot_id 883e3008... confirms restart; inventory-app active and serving JSON afterward

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state

selected_evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state

selected_evidence.requirement: Final overall health/persistence across all nodes after full restart cycle
